segments.en: Know and believe with complete faith — that nothing whatsoever — and no light service — is ever lost. And even a mere arousal. And all the more so when one performs some act of holiness — then immediately the true Tzadik — who is engaged in the repair of the souls of Israel — seizes it. And brings it to the place where he brings it — for the need of the most wondrous and awesome building — that he is engaged in building. To bring within it all the displaced ones in the world. And not one of them will remain outside.
— Additions — Saba writes: "I do not know from where these come"
